go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Age

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "integer",
  "minimum": 1,
  "maximum": 150
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/agepkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestAge_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`42`)
	var a Age
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &a); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if a != 42 {
		t.Errorf("Unmarshal = %d, want 42", int(a))
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(a)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != "42" {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want 42", out)
	}
}

func TestAge_BelowMin(t *testing.T) {
	var a Age
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`0`), &a)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want minimum rejection")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "below minimum 1") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want minimum message", err)
	}
}

func TestAge_AboveMax(t *testing.T) {
	var a Age
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`200`), &a)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want maximum rejection")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "above maximum 150") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want maximum message", err)
	}
}
